sections.description:

Premium Widgets in Free Version

  • AI Chatbot: Show an AI-powered live chat box.

  • Popup Anywhere: Show custom popups anywhere.

  • Products Carousel: Create engaging product sliders.

  • Video Gallery: Showcase your video content.

  • Table of Contents: Improve readability.

UnlockAddons Features/Extenions/Modules

  • AI Text Generator: Create Engaging Content Instantly.

  • Google Sheets: Show Live Google Sheets Data Anywhere in Elementor.

Why Choose Unlock Addons for Elementor?

✅ Works with Elementor Free – No need for Elementor Pro. All widgets work perfectly with the free version.

✅ Lightweight & Fast – Only loads assets for widgets you actually use. No bloat, no slowdowns.

✅ 18 Professional Widgets – From email capture to dynamic charts, we’ve got everything covered.

✅ Fully Customizable – Every widget is fully customizable using Elementor’s native controls.

✅ WooCommerce Ready – Perfect widgets for showcasing products and boosting sales.

✅ SEO-Friendly – Built with clean code and semantic HTML for better search rankings.

✅ Mobile Responsive – All widgets are fully responsive and look great on any device.

✅ Regular Updates – We continuously improve the plugin with new features and bug fixes.

Performance & Optimization

Built with performance as a top priority:

  • Selective Asset Loading – Only loads CSS/JS for widgets you use
  • Minified Code – All assets are minified for faster loading
  • Lazy Loading – Images and heavy content load on demand
  • Caching Friendly – Works perfectly with all major caching plugins
  • Clean Code – WordPress-compliant code with no bloat
  • Regular Updates – Continuous performance improvements

Security & Privacy

  • GDPR Compliant – Cookie consent and data handling
  • Secure Code – Regular security audits and updates
  • Data Protection – Email capture with IP tracking
  • WordPress Standards – Follows all WordPress coding standards

Mobile Responsive

All widgets are fully responsive and work perfectly on:
* Desktop computers
* Tablets
* Mobile phones
* All screen sizes and orientations

Design Flexibility

Every widget offers:
* Full Elementor styling controls
* Custom colors, typography, and spacing
* Border and shadow options
* Background customization
* Animation effects
* Responsive controls for mobile, tablet, and desktop

From WordPress Dashboard

  1. Navigate to Plugins → Add New
  2. Search for “Unlock Addons for Elementor”
  3. Click Install Now
  4. Click Activate

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP from WordPress.org
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  3. Upload the ZIP file
  4. Click Install Now
  5. Click Activate Plugin

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.5 or higher
  • Elementor Free (latest version recommended)
  • PHP 7.2 or higher

sections.faq:
Do I need Elementor Pro?

No! All 40+ widgets work perfectly with Elementor Free. You don’t need to purchase Elementor Pro to use any of our widgets.

Will this plugin slow down my website?

Absolutely not! Unlock Addons uses smart asset loading – it only loads CSS and JavaScript for widgets you actually use on each page. This means minimal performance impact and faster page loads.

Is there a premium version?

Currently, all features are available in the free version. We’re committed to providing powerful tools without forcing upgrades.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes! We have dedicated WooCommerce widgets including Product Grid, Product Carousel, Customer Review, and Sync Advantage that integrate seamlessly with WooCommerce.

Can I customize the widgets?

Absolutely! Every widget is fully customizable using Elementor’s native style controls. You can change colors, typography, spacing, borders, shadows, and much more.

Does it work with all WordPress themes?

Yes! Unlock Addons is designed to work with any WordPress theme that supports Elementor. This includes all major themes like Astra, GeneratePress, Kadence, and thousands of others.

Is the plugin mobile responsive?

Yes! All 40+ widgets are fully responsive and look great on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices. You can even customize mobile-specific settings in Elementor.

How often is the plugin updated?

We release regular updates to add new features, improve performance, fix bugs, and maintain compatibility with the latest WordPress and Elementor versions.

Can I use multiple widgets on the same page?

Yes! You can use as many widgets as you want on any page. Each widget loads independently, so there’s no performance penalty.

Does the Email Capture widget store data?

Yes, the Email Capture widget stores submissions in your WordPress database. You can view and manage all email captures from the admin panel, organize them by categories, and export data if needed.

What page builders are supported?

Unlock Addons is built specifically for Elementor. It works with both Elementor Free and Elementor Pro.

Is there documentation available?

Yes! Visit our support center for detailed documentation, video tutorials, and guides.

Can I request new widgets or features?

We love hearing from our users! Visit our support page to submit feature requests or suggestions.
